The MacBook Neo is Apple's most controversial and most important Mac in years — a $600 laptop running the A18 Pro mobile chip with 8GB of memory, no haptic Force Touch trackpad, no backlit keyboard, no notch, no ambient light sensor, and the best repairability of any MacBook in over a decade. Compared head-to-head against the M5 MacBook Air, M1 MacBook Air, M4 Mac mini, iPad Pro, Microsoft Surface, and entry-level Chromebooks and Windows laptops, the Neo proves Apple's pricing premium is officially dead.
